title: Coconut Rice (Thengai Sadam)
tagline: Mild, nutty rice with fresh coconut and a crunchy lentil-and-cashew tempering.
intro: Coconut rice is a fragrant South Indian favourite where fluffy rice is tossed with fresh grated coconut and a golden tempering of lentils, cashews and curry leaves. Subtly sweet and nutty, it's a festival dish and a fine way to transform plain rice into something special.
rice: Cooked, cooled basmati or short-grain rice

items: 1 cup fresh grated coconut (or ¾ cup desiccated, moistened)
1 tbsp chana dal, 1 tbsp urad dal

method: Heat oil and pop the mustard seeds; add the chana dal, urad dal and cashews and fry until golden.
Add the red chillies, green chillies, ginger, curry leaves and asafoetida; sauté briefly.
Add the grated coconut and fry gently for 2–3 minutes until fragrant and lightly toasted (don't brown too much).
Add the cooked rice and salt, and toss gently until evenly combined and heated through.
tips: Fresh coconut gives the best flavour; if using desiccated, sprinkle with a little warm water first.
Coconut oil deepens the aroma authentically.
toServe: Pairs well with a spicy pickle or a simple vegetable curry.
imageAlt: Coconut rice with cashews, lentils and curry leaves
